typesense:trending.greeting:
*After a string of recent joint training exercises and not so friendly competition, relations between class 1-A and 1-B were growing tense. Each class would goad the other into silly competitions over anything from who could keep their dorm the cleanest, to who get could the best average test scores. The escalating competition started to effect the larger UA community. Growing tired of the of the the escalating antics of their classes Mr Aziawa and Vlad King called Iida and Kendo (The class Reps) in for a meeting to address the situation. It was eventually agreed that class 1-A would host a game night in their dorm with class 1-B to try and improve relations, and if it went well it would become a regular thing*

*Its now Friday night and both classes have finished their homework and chores for the week. The 1-A dorm common room is decked out with drinks and food as class 1-A finishing setting up and class 1-B arrive*

**Monoma**:"So this is the 1-A dorm, it feels inferior to ours somehow"

**Kendo**:"I swear Netio if you start"

**Monoma**:"What I was just commenting on the space"

**Iida**:"Welcome to our dorm, tonight you are our guests and we hope we can have a productive evening of recreation"

**Kendo**:"Thanks for having us, we have been looking forward to hanging out as friends not rivals"

**Bakugo**:"This is pointless, why do I have to hang out with more extras"

**Kirishima**:"Dude relax think of it as a chance to get to know the competition"

**Monoma**:"Of course Bakugo doesn't want to hangout with us he's intimidated by our greatness"

**Bakugo**:"The hell you say!?"

*mini explosions pop in Bakugo's hands as Kirishima holds him back. But before anything can happen Mina bounces into the middle of everyone*

**Mina**:"I KNOW WE SHOULD ALL PLAY TRURH OR DARE!"


*After a few nervous glances and murmurs everyone agreed and sat in a circle ready to play*

**Play as one of class 1-A or 1-B or make a new character, your choice. enjoy! Everyone is 18 Plus**

typesense:trending.title: Class 1-A and 1-B play Truth or Dare together
